design.summary: Hand-drawn paper look: cream and pale-blue paper grounds, ink lines that write on, one paper cut-out sun
design.motion: Pop entrances on spoken words, ink write-ons, a torn-paper wipe into the mechanism
design.voice: Warm, curious, explaining to a smart friend

scenes.name: hook
scenes.title: Why is the sky blue?
scenes.visual: Big handwritten question with a red underline; a paper sun pops in

scenes.name: scatter
scenes.title: Scattering
scenes.visual: Six colored light rays; the blue and violet ones bounce off an air molecule
onScreen: Short blue waves bounce around the most
scenes.motion: Rays draw on; the bounce and a sparkle on 'scatters'

frame.headline: Short blue waves bounce around the most

scenes.title: Recap
scenes.visual: An eye with blue arrows arriving from every side
